episode.title: This GIANT ANACONDA Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a minimal studio sand set, a colossal anaconda takes a performer into its mouth in one unbroken shot, and the crew force the practical jaws open so he steps out unharmed.

shots.prompt:
ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS. A built film set reads immediately: bare studio concrete around a shallow island of sand and earth with a few scattered rocks, a tall blue screen wall with pale blue cross tracking markers behind it, a wide overhead grid of white diffusion softboxes above, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man. The creature's jaws open wide and close over him until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth. Crew members rush in, put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and in the final seconds the same one man climbs out onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. The camera pushes in slowly from the wide establishing frame toward the action throughout, in one unbroken take.

The giant anaconda lies coiled across the sand island, its head raised level with a bearded man in a dusty field shirt who stands his ground and watches its jaws part. The head drives forward, the jaws close over him, and he is completely out of sight inside the mouth as the coils settle. Four crew members in dark clothing run in from beside the dolly track, brace their hands on the upper and lower jaw and force the mouth open; in the final seconds the same man climbs out onto the sand, upright and unharmed, while the seam of the hinged practical jaw stays open behind him. Crew keep filming throughout. Ambient sound only: footsteps on sand, studio air handling and crew movement.

object_card.name: giant anaconda
object_card.descriptor: a colossal olive-green anaconda twelve metres long, its wet scales patterned with dark oval blotches, small amber eyes set high on a broad blunt head, and a pale cream throat that stretches as its jaws part
object_card.framing: A slow continuous push-in moves from a wide establishing frame of the whole set toward the anaconda's head and the man.
object_card.anomaly_descriptor: Crew hands brace on the upper and lower jaw and force the hinged practical mouth open in the final reveal.
